verdict.rationale: Docusaurus documents a versioning CLI that snapshots the current docs into a new documentation version, and it advertises versioning tied to project releases, so the publishing half of the story is first-party. Nothing in the evidence explicitly shows readers switching versions on the published site. Missing for 10: documented reader-facing version switcher (e.g. a navbar version dropdown), detail on how per-version URLs and routing work, independent or hands-on corroboration of versioning.

support.subject: As a developer, I publish versioned documentation per product or API version, and readers switch versions from the site

citations.quote: You can use the versioning CLI to create a new documentation version based on the latest content in the docs directory.
Support users on all versions of your project. Document versioning helps you keep documentation in sync with project releases.
